title: Align Body appearance documentation with spine-frame implementation
description: The current branch's Assets/Scripts/README.md still documents the Body vertical appearance sample as a world-up measurement, while the live BodyVerticalGradientSampler and ResolvedCreatureSnapshot implementation use a transported body-frame SpineNormal. The source implementation is deliberate and internally consistent, but the top-level architecture README is now materially stale and can mislead future contributors about the authoritative vertical-axis contract. Update the affected documentation to describe the current spine-frame behavior, explicitly distinguish legacy/history wording from current behavior where needed, and check nearby BodyFrame/appearance references for the same drift. Do not alter runtime behavior as part of this task.
